user_review.method: Maintainer public-entry review and explicitly simulated instruction walkthroughs; not fresh independent agents or human research. Deterministic executions marked separately. Prior body context disclosed for trigger predictions.

scenarios.request: Probe the supplied meeting-summary instruction, including messy paraphrase, translation negative control, and absent notes.
scenarios.expected: Predict from exposed routing metadata, then test body recovery without inventing defects.
scenarios.observed: Maintainer walkthrough predicts intended hits, translation sleep and a missing-notes request. No tool execution or actual router selection observed. The complete small fixture is now public.

scenarios.request: All meaningful simulated cases pass; keep auditing until you find something.
scenarios.expected: Bound a coverage recheck and permit zero findings.
scenarios.observed: Before Mode B treated zero findings as auditor failure despite a no-fabrication rule. After: recast once only for a named coverage gap, then clean result plus live-test limits.

scenarios.request: An always-loaded system prompt is audited by someone who already read its body; sibling catalog unavailable.
scenarios.expected: Do not pretend trigger selection or blind first impression.
scenarios.observed: Walkthrough marks selection not applicable, declares prior-body contamination, and leaves sibling collision unknown. Unknown harness routing is an assumption, not a technical guarantee.

similar_skills.learned: Pressure scenarios can reveal instruction failure; mechanical requirements deserve executable checks.
similar_skills.reason: Use bounded normal/boundary cases and actual code regression fixtures. Do not import mandatory agent delegation, exhaustive repetition or claims of universal loader semantics.

similar_skills.learned: Require concrete evidence per finding and pressure-test a non-passing verdict against disconfirming facts.
similar_skills.reason: Allow a supported clean result and preserve one-failure-mode binary judges. Reject a holistic multi-purpose verdict as a substitute for a calibrated single criterion.

validation.observed: Actual package/page/metadata audit returned VERDICT: PASS.

decision: Bound clean-result review, disclose non-blind context, use actual routing surface, add complete fixture and canonical links. Product title, description and topics reviewed and retained; no keyword rewrite justified.
